svg.title: The publish workflow, phase by phase
svg.desc: Phases 0 to 10 run top to bottom in four stages. Prepare: precedence, preflight and rebase. Verify: review, gate, documentation and commit. Ship: push, change request, CI, and an infrastructure plan review only when infrastructure is affected. Settle: feedback. Then the report gives the verdict at the checked head: passed only when every step passed or was not applicable, otherwise blocked. Review findings, a failing gate step, red CI and feedback fixes all go back to review along one blue loop on the left; changed documentation re-runs the gate. A panel on the right groups the early exits. Hand over: another publish skill, gate tool or agent rule owns publishing. Stop: the base branch, a dirty tree, no forge adapter or no forge login, or a rebase conflict. Block: a fifth review round still finding defects, a required gate step that cannot run, a frontend change without visual evidence or a disclosure, CI still running past its timeout, missing, partial or stale plan evidence, and a feedback point still raised after two rounds or new findings on a third pass. When animated, a token runs one publish: each phase lights as it is reached, a feedback fix takes the loop back to review and every phase after it runs again, and the run ends at the report with passed; nothing moves when reduced motion is preferred.
svg.text: From a committed branch to a reviewed change request with green CI and settled feedback.
